headline: Masco Corporation to Participate in a Fireside Chat at an Investor Conference
summary: LIVONIA, Mich., August 04, 2026--Masco Corporation (NYSE: MAS) announced today that Rick Westenberg, Vice President, Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer, will participate in a fireside chat at the Deutsche Bank Chicago Industrials Summit 2026 in Chicago, Illinois on Tuesday, August 11, at 11:00 a.m. ET.

headline: 1 S&P 500 Stock to Target This Week and 2 We Brush Off
summary: While the S&P 500 (^GSPC) includes industry leaders, not every stock in the index is a winner. Some companies are past their prime, weighed down by poor execution, weak financials, or structural headwinds.
